pages.title: Heavy Turrets
pages.text: Heavy turrets target only hostile subspaces or use manual head-aim control.$(br2)AeroIE does not want a solo pilot to lose access to the full potential of a weapon system through frantic micromanagement, but it still lets you manually operate the truly big guns when necessary.

Heavy turrets use the same weapon channels as fixed weapons; see $(l:vsie:weapon/weapon_channel)Weapons: Channels/$. In automatic mode, a turret aims at a hostile subspace and fires whenever its channel is active.$(br2)In manual mode, it follows the view direction of the player in its linked Control Seat. While the channel is active, press the fire control to shoot.

The GUI provides three modes: Automatic fires at hostile subspaces; Manual uses head-aim control while the player's view is unlocked and waits while view lock is enabled; Smart uses Manual while view is unlocked and Automatic while view lock is enabled. The GUI also provides the same default-angle settings as a standard turret.
